verdict.rationale: Paddle documents generating reports via the API and dashboard to feed accounting and BI systems, including payout reconciliation and a subscriptions report covering every subscription, plus dashboard/API access to account metrics. Its fully OpenAPI-specified API exposes account entities programmatically. This is first-party data extraction, but nothing documents a complete account export, the export file formats, or an offboarding path. missing for 10: documented full-account/bulk data export, explicit open file formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), payment-method/customer data portability for migrating away, offboarding/exit documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
